detail_checks.title: Healer Unranked: Rebirth of the Strongest Archmage Book Two
observations: Title and subtitle explicitly name OP MC, cozy slice of life and LitRPG adventure.
Description opens with a compact threat, establishes warm daily life, then breaks it with horror and ends with a trope promise.
Cover uses a very large fantasy title, luminous blue-gold magic, a small central character and a visible book number.
The observed edition displayed 243 Kindle pages, EUR 4.29 and 255 ratings.

detail_checks.title: Starter Zone Survivor
observations: Title names the scenario and subtitle states LitRPG survival progression fantasy.
Description starts with the anomaly, uses short escalating skill examples, gives the protagonist a personal goal and closes with an explicit feature list.
The observed edition displayed 377 Kindle pages, EUR 4.29, 1,283 ratings and a five-book series.
Visible review synthesis praised premise, engagement and pace but reported confusion, repetition and perceived AI-like prose. Packaging did not remove the quality penalty.

detail_checks.title: Evaluation
observations: A short abstract title works with an explicit series label, a clear System premise and strong series depth.
Description establishes the System, survival stakes, protagonist competence, personal family objective and expected game mechanics.
Cover uses one large word, a solitary figure, environmental scale and strong light-dark contrast.
The observed edition displayed 416 Kindle pages, EUR 4.29, 5,513 ratings and a six-book series; visible review synthesis emphasized readability, character, pace and progression.

observed_patterns.observation: Eight of twelve sampled titles state LitRPG or progression language directly in the title or subtitle; known franchises can rely more heavily on series recognition.
observed_patterns.application: A new RN10-003 title must carry LitRPG and system-apocalypse language in visible metadata.

observed_patterns.observation: Nine of twelve sampled titles state a series, installment or book number in the displayed title; all three inspected detail pages also expose a series card.
observed_patterns.application: Launch RN10-003 as Book 1 with a stable series name and a complete first-book objective.

observed_patterns.observation: Nine of twelve sampled Kindle prices cluster from EUR 4.29 through EUR 5.16 in the France-delivery view.
observed_patterns.application: Use USD marketplace pricing and KENPC economics at production time; treat the observed cluster as a reference, not an automatic price.

observed_patterns.observation: Visible covers prioritize a large readable title, one dominant character or ensemble, high contrast and fantasy or System lighting; series identity repeats across volumes.
observed_patterns.evidence_basis: Bestseller-grid visual inspection plus three detail pages
observed_patterns.application: Use a large GOOD DOG / BAD SYSTEM title, one lovable dog focal point, warm domestic light against a dark city and one neon System accent.

observed_patterns.observation: All three inspected descriptions establish the anomaly or threat early, identify the protagonist's concrete objective and state the progression or trope promise.
observed_patterns.application: RN10-003 description must open on the dog/System anomaly, name the home-building objective and close with explicit genre features.

observed_patterns.observation: Warm or light daily life can coexist with severe background stakes; current listing and review language shows readers can understand this contrast when both halves are stated.
observed_patterns.evidence_basis: Healer Unranked description and Evaluation review synthesis
observed_patterns.application: Keep the sincere cozy opening, then state the black-comic System-apocalypse destination in subtitle, cover and description.

observed_patterns.observation: Review language rewards a distinctive premise, understandable protagonist, progression, pace and series pull, while confusion, repetition and perceived machine-like prose remain visible negatives.
observed_patterns.application: Add editorial gates for causal clarity, repetition, character attachment, progression cadence and human-sounding prose; listing optimization cannot substitute for them.

without_paid_impressions.limit: These outcomes do not reveal impressions and therefore cannot separate visibility from conversion.

with_separately_authorized_amazon_ads.limit: Title and subtitle are not test surfaces after publication because KDP locks them.

limitations: The bestseller page is updated frequently and this is one dated snapshot.
Ratings, prices and ranks are not unit sales and do not reveal advertising spend.
Dungeon Crawler Carl dominates the top positions and is an incumbent outlier, not a newcomer baseline.
Amazon's France-delivery view displayed EUR conversions; final pricing must use the target marketplace directly.
Visual observations cover the visible grid and three detail pages rather than every sampled cover.
Co-occurring listing features cannot establish which feature caused a sale.
